item.title: What happens when people have to jump in to clean up AI’s mess?
item.description: As AI takes on more work, some human capabilities will inevitably be used less often. Imagine an artificial intelligence system that has performed reliably for months. Its recommendations are almost always right, and the employee reviewing them has learned that close scrutiny rarely changes the outcome. Then something unusual happens. The AI makes an error or can’t proceed and needs human intervention. The employee is expected to step in and remains responsible for the outcome....
